alt: 拼圖只完成一半，孩子已離開桌子去玩別的，剩下的拼片散在旁邊。
scene_prompt: 半途而廢 means abandoning a task halfway before completion. In a modern child's room a large scenic jigsaw puzzle lies HALF assembled on the foreground desk: the left side clearly completed, the entire right side empty with many loose pieces beside it. The SAME child who started it has pushed the chair back and is walking away from the unfinished puzzle to play with a simple toy robot on the carpet, looking disinterested in finishing. Foreground unfinished work dominates composition, not a completed puzzle or child merely taking a brief snack break. No branded toys, no text. Gentle relatable everyday example, no moralizing adult.
